title.zh: 风险与回报 · 为什么风险大承诺回报高
title.en: Risk & Return · Why Do Riskier Things Usually Promise More

desc.zh: 波动大的东西必须承诺更高回报才有人愿意承担；但承诺不等于到手，分布比平均数更诚实。
desc.en: Volatile options must promise more to attract takers — but a promise is not a payout; the distribution is more honest than the average.
